users.title: Users
users.description: Manage who can access the application and what they can do.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with upper and lower case letters, a digit and a symbol.

form.createDescription: The user will be able to sign in immediately.
form.rolesSearch: Search roles by name or code…

delete.title: Delete user?
delete.description: {name} will lose access immediately and all active sessions will end. The record can be restored later.

toast.sessionsEnded: {count, plural, =0 {No active sessions} one {# session ended} other {# sessions ended}}

validation.username: 3–64 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. +251911000000.

actions.unlockHint: Clear the lock after failed sign-ins
actions.resetHint: Set a temporary password and sign them out
actions.endSessionsHint: End every active session of this user
actions.deleteHint: Soft-deletes the account; it can be restored
actions.selfHint: Not available for your own account

reset.title: Reset password
reset.warning: The user will be signed out of every device and must use the new password.
reset.done: Password reset for {name}. Share it through a secure channel.

endSessions.title: Sign this user out everywhere?
endSessions.description: {name} will be signed out of every device immediately.

bulk.sessionsEnded: {count, plural, one {# user was signed out everywhere} other {# users were signed out everywhere}}
bulk.failed: {count, plural, one {# user could not be updated} other {# users could not be updated}}

import.title: Import users
import.description: Create many users from a CSV file. Imported accounts receive a random password — issue credentials with “Reset password”.
